text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, as I stepped out into 
the morning sunlight, 
Azuma-san was already waiting.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the look in your eyes... you 
are ready 
to decide on the course of practice with <chrname> 
-sama.
choice_data_list:
After what happened with Blast yesterday, 
yes.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Then it would be wise to craft your 
plan 
based on the "teachings" you received 
during your previous study session.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And in time, 
you shall receive mine as well...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now then, Trainer, Divine Steed. 
Whenever you are ready—call the first 
tune.
